# Design point P017

## Description

A centralized Git hosting service would serve repositories whose copies are replicated across distinct racks, while clients use partial clones to limit transferred objects and local storage. The centralized-hosting choice does not specify how unhealthy replicas are detected, repaired, isolated, or bypassed, so those failure-handling behaviors remain undefined.
